title: Curated usage ledger line
description: One line of <store>/usage.jsonl, the curated store's append-only usage ledger: every view, save, edit, forget and helped or harmed sighting of a memory, by name; the index ranks memories by it. Source: memory/curated/store.go (usageLine, appendUsage, Usage, the Event constants).

quote.description: A helped or harmed event's evidence.

user.description: A helped event whose quote is a user's words.

record.description: The record a corrected, cited or promoted event names.
